## Privacy reminder

Please **never** paste your `POESESSID`, account cookies, or raw personal logs into a public issue. If you want to attach diagnostics, use **Settings -> Report a problem** inside Arbiter to generate a redacted `.arbiter-report` file and drop it in the project Discord (`https://discord.gg/xxEDMkfqJg`).
